title: Five regions, then the done test

steps.say: Five regions first, with clean file names. Open two of the PDFs and check a number against the data before going further.
The done test: add a region to the list and run the script. Its PDF appears, and nothing else was edited.

final:
library(tidyverse)

regions <- c("Riyadh", "Makkah", "Eastern Province",
             "Asir", "Tabuk", "Jazan")

walk(regions, \(r) {
  slug <- r |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all(" ", "-")
  quarto::quarto_render(
    "note.qmd",
    output_format = "typst",
    execute_params = list(region = r),
    output_file = str_glue("note-{slug}.pdf")
  )
})
